answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch as a result pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the meadow solution is checked at the garden gate and logged, the horizon audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 25 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. That is 5 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
